questions.q: In whose house did the two spies lodge in Jericho?
questions.evidence: They went and came into the house of a prostitute whose name was Rahab, and slept there

questions.q: What did Rahab tie in the window so her house would be spared?
questions.evidence: Behold, when we come into the land, tie this line of scarlet thread in the window which you used to let us down

questions.q: When the priests stood in the Jordan, how did all Israel cross?
questions.evidence: and all Israel crossed over on dry ground, until all the nation had passed completely over the Jordan

questions.q: How many stones were taken from the middle of the Jordan?
How many times were they to march around Jericho on the seventh day?
questions.evidence: On the seventh day, you shall march around the city seven times, and the priests shall blow the trumpets

questions.q: What happened to the wall of Jericho when the people shouted?
questions.evidence: When the people heard the sound of the trumpet, the people shouted with a great shout, and the wall fell down flat, so that the people went up into the city, every man straight in front of him, and they took the city

questions.q: Who took some of the devoted things at Jericho?
questions.evidence: for Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took some of the devoted things

questions.q: During the battle for Gibeon, what stood still in the sky?
questions.evidence: The sun stood still, and the moon stayed, until the nation had avenged themselves of their enemies

questions.q: How did the Gibeonites trick Joshua into a treaty?
options: By claiming to come from far away
By sending their king as a hostage
questions.evidence: They went to Joshua at the camp at Gilgal, and said to him and to the men of Israel, “We have come from a far country

questions.q: "As for me and my house," Joshua said, "we will" do what?
questions.evidence: but as for me and my house, we will serve Yahweh
